data.purpose: Timings, percentages, and engine status only.

shadows.name: coal-glow
shadows.value: canvas shadowBlur on cells above level 170, rgba(255, 107, 44, 0.75)
shadows.purpose: Hot coals only. Turns off when drawing gets slow.

motion.name: ignite
motion.purpose: The grid heating up on load, once.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that runs the engine on the visitor's machine.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; background: #ff6b2c; border: 1px solid #ff6b2c; border-radius: 3px; color: #15110e; font-weight: 600; transition: background 0.15s linear; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #ffd696; border-color: #ffd696; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary controls. Turns ember while on or under the pointer.
components.css: .ds-quiet { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; background: none; border: 1px solid #5c4d41; border-radius: 3px; color: #ede5d8; transition: color 0.15s linear, border-color 0.15s linear; } .ds-quiet:hover { color: #ff6b2c; border-color: #ff6b2c; }

narrative.overview: A dark page around a grid the engine is computing live. The layout comes from the author's Tink and MedData sites, and the palette is its own.

rules.name: The Live Ember Rule
rules.body: If it is orange, it is live, measured, or under the pointer.

donts: Don't use mono as a costume.
